csv_agency: State of Colorado Dept of Personnel & Admin
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Colorado, Department of Personnel & Administration (DPA) is soliciting Requests for Qualifications for Architectural/Engineering Services (A/E) for the modernization of the restrooms at the State Office Building (SOB). The restrooms throughout SOB are dated and out of compliance with assorted code and accessibility requirements and in need of full renovation. This also includes a requirement to add gender neutral restroom(s) facilities to adhere to State of Colorado requirements for public buildings.
